title: Multi-Resolution Feature Fusion U-Net for Magnetic Resonance Imaging Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2610.00279v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The segmentation of anatomical structures in medical images and particularly in MRI scans, is essential for clinical diagnosis and monitoring disease progression. While Deep Learning (DL) architectures, such as U-Net and its extensions are very effective in medical image segmentation tasks, they often struggle with preserving fine-grained details and global contextual information. This is especially challenging for MRI data segmentation, where anatomical structures are characterized by irregular boundaries and variations in shape, contrast, and scale. To address this challenge, we propose a novel DL architecture for MRI segmentation across different anatomical structures. Specifically, the architecture introduces a module, named Multi-Resolution Feature Fusion (MRFF), that can be easily integrated into any U-Net-like architecture. translated_title: 用于磁共振成像分割的多分辨率特征融合U-Net
translated_abstract: 医学图像中解剖结构的分割，尤其是在MRI扫描中的分割，对于临床诊断和疾病进展监测至关重要。虽然深度学习（DL）架构（如U-Net及其扩展）在医学图像分割任务中非常有效，但它们往往难以保留细粒度细节和全局上下文信息。这对于MRI数据分割而言尤其具有挑战性，因为解剖结构具有不规则边界，并且在形状、对比度和尺度上存在变化。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的深度学习架构，用于跨不同解剖结构的MRI分割。具体而言，该架构引入了一个名为多分辨率特征融合（MRFF）的模块，该模块可以轻松集成到任何类U-Net架构中。MRFF被集成在编码-解码结构的所有层级中，并结合了注意力机制等...
tldr: 提出了一种包含多分辨率特征融合（MRFF）模块的新型U-Net架构，可有效保留细粒度细节和全局上下文信息，从而提升MRI医学图像分割的准确性。
en_tdlr: A novel U-Net-based architecture with an easily integrable Multi-Resolution Feature Fusion (MRFF) module is proposed to preserve fine-grained details and global context, improving MRI segmentation accuracy across anatomical structures.
